description: This file defines a custom authentication state provider for a Blazor WebAssembly application. It manages user authentication state by fetching user details from a web API, caching the user info, and updating the claims principal accordingly.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of AuthenticationStateProvider that fetches user info from an API and manages user authentication state with caching.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method to retrieve the current authentication state, utilizing cached data if valid.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Fetches the user claims principal, using cache if specified and still valid.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Performs HTTP request to retrieve user info and constructs the ClaimsPrincipal based on retrieved data.
